## Objective
The repository is empty. Add a single Java source file that prints a greeting, so the project has a runnable hello world.

## Interface
File: `src/main/java/HelloWorld.java`, default package, containing `public class HelloWorld` with `public static void main(String[] args)`.

## Behavior
1. Running the program prints exactly `Hello, World!` followed by a newline to standard output.
2. It exits with status 0.

## Invariants
Plain JDK only, no build tool, no dependencies.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Do not add other files, build scripts or tests.

## Out of scope
Build tooling (Maven/Gradle), packages, tests.
